document_api_meta.title: Create Size Chart V2
document_api_meta.env_desc: Create one size chart from structured table data. Use `REUSABLE_TEMPLATE` to create a seller template that can be reused across products, or `PRODUCT_SCOPED` to create a chart for a single product. The response returns the created size chart ID. The request must identify one authorized shop using shop_cipher.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc: The cipher identifying the authorized shop for this request. Obtain it from Get Authorized Shops and use the value for the shop whose size chart is being created or edited.

request_body_param.name: category_id
request_body_param.desc: The leaf category for which to create the size chart. The category must support size charts.

request_body_param.name: ^is_one_size
request_body_param.desc: Whether this is a one-size chart.

request_body_param.name: ^measurement_type
request_body_param.desc: Possible values: GENERIC_MEASUREMENTS: generic measurements; BODY_MEASUREMENTS: shopper body measurements; PRODUCT_MEASUREMENTS: finished-product measurements.

request_body_param.name: ^size_types
request_body_param.desc: Possible values: size_chart_common_size_type: Common; size_chart_size_type_regular: Regular; size_chart_size_type_juniors: Juniors; size_chart_size_type_plus: Plus; size_chart_size_type_big&tall: Big & Tall; size_chart_size_type_petite: Petite. Available values depend on the category.

request_body_param.name: ^^headers
request_body_param.desc: Ordered header definitions. Provide 1 to 20 headers.

request_body_param.name: ^^^id
request_body_param.desc:
Standard size-system or measurement ID.
For standard measurement columns, call Get Category Rules for the corresponding category and use the ID from measurement_and_options[].options[].id under the applicable measurement_type.
For size-system columns, use the following predefined IDs:
- Size: size_chart_size_system_size
- US: size_chart_size_system_us
- UK: size_chart_size_system_uk
- EU: size_chart_size_system_eu
- JP: size_chart_size_system_jp
- MX: size_chart_size_system_mx
Omit this field for custom columns.

request_body_param.name: ^^^name
request_body_param.desc: Header display name. Maximum length: 32 characters.

request_body_param.name: ^^rows
request_body_param.desc: Rows of the size chart. Provide 1 to 45 rows.

request_body_param.name: ^^^cells
request_body_param.desc: Cells aligned by index with `table.headers`. Each row must contain exactly one cell for every header.

request_body_param.name: ^unit_system
request_body_param.desc: Possible values: METRIC: metric units; IMPERIAL: imperial units.

request_body_param.name: size_chart_mode
request_body_param.desc:
Possible values:
REUSABLE_TEMPLATE: A size chart template that can be reused across multiple products.
PRODUCT_SCOPED: A size chart created for and used by a single product.

request_body_param.name: template_name
request_body_param.desc:
Template name. Required when size_chart_mode is REUSABLE_TEMPLATE.
When size_chart_mode is PRODUCT_SCOPED, any value provided for this field is discarded and is not stored.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: ^size_chart_id
response_param.desc: The ID of the created size chart. For REUSABLE_TEMPLATE mode, use this value as size_chart.template.id in subsequent product APIs. For PRODUCT_SCOPED mode, this ID identifies a size chart specific to a single product and cannot be reused as a template ID.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
